lens.title: Before It Becomes Final
lens.intro: A small disagreement is easier to adjust today than the larger ending your silence may eventually create.
lens.pull_quote: Say what is becoming difficult while it is still a changeable part of the arrangement.
lens.deeper_read: You can absorb a great deal without making the room pay for it. That endurance is useful until it turns a manageable request into proof that you must leave; let the other person meet the smaller truth first while the arrangement can still change without drama.
lens.watch_for: Watch for taking a familiar escape route after one more request lands harder than it should.
lens.move: Name the adjustment before your patience has to become a departure.

lens.title: Trust The Pattern
lens.intro: A worthwhile opening may not need perfect certainty, only enough evidence to distinguish it from a polished distraction.
lens.pull_quote: You can leave the familiar position when the new direction has proved more than its first impression.
lens.deeper_read: You will see both the opportunity and the reasons to wait. Let the decision rest on what has repeated, who follows through, and which missing detail would actually change the answer—not every possible objection.
lens.watch_for: Watch for asking for another opinion after the practical evidence has already converged.
lens.move: Choose the next test that lets the opportunity prove itself in real life.

lens.title: Leave Some Ground
lens.intro: A strong opportunity can be worth moving toward when it offers a life you can inhabit, not just a temporary rush.
lens.pull_quote: You are not betraying what you built by choosing the expansion that gives it a larger future.
lens.deeper_read: You need more than novelty before leaving solid ground, and that is wisdom. Today, ask whether the opening has durable shape and enough freedom to keep you from rebuilding the same constraint somewhere new.
lens.watch_for: Watch for calling a real next step temporary because staying familiar feels more responsible.
lens.move: Take the smallest irreversible-looking step that still leaves the future open.
